routes.label: in South Sudan, payable in pounds at the Central Bank's rate

note: The Director-General's circular under the Financial Act 2024-25, effective 16 December 2024, as Sudans Post reported it: 100 dollars for an adult's regular passport, 50 for a minor's, charged at the Central Bank's prevailing rate or its equivalent; a minor is taken as under 18. Passports are valid ten years since the Director-General's directive reported on 5 December 2022. Processing time isn't read.

sources.title: Sudans Post, South Sudan raises fees for nationality, passports (16 December 2024)
sources.said: Simon Majur Pabek, Director-General of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration, announced the new fees in a circular seen by Sudans Post. ... The Financial Act will take immediate effect from December 16, 2024. All immigration visa and passport fees or charges indicated in U.S. dollars should be charged at the Central Bank’s prevailing rate or its equivalent. ... An adult’s regular passport now costs $100, a minor’s regular passport costs $50

sources.title: Sudans Post, South Sudan extends lifespan of passports to ten years (5 December 2022)
sources.said: South Sudan’s ministry of interior has extended the lifespan of passports to at least ten years, according to statements by the director-general of nationality, passports, and immigration General Atem Biar Marol. ... “We gave directives to extend the validity period of the passport from five years to ten years, and I have already directed the ICT department to make amendments to the printing system,”
